tools.name: search_humans
tools.title: Search humans
tools.description: Search for available humans by skill or rate; location ranks local humans first. Returns public profiles with a profileUrl.

skill.description: Skill to search for (e.g. "web development", "data entry")

country.description: Country name or code to rank first

limit.description: Results per page (default 50, max 100). Without sign-in, pass limit 24 or less: the default of 50 and any larger value are rejected, not reduced.

tools.name: browse_taste_humans
tools.title: Browse creative humans
tools.description: Browse humans with creative/taste skills (design, visual art, music, photo & video, fashion & style, writing & performance), curated for work needing human aesthetic judgment.

skill.description: Case-insensitive skill or expertise substring (e.g. "logo design")

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call

tools.name: create_taste_run
tools.title: Create taste run
tools.description: Pay a panel of vetted creative humans to compare 2-6 linked artifacts and answer an aesthetic judgment question. Optional requirements can filter by creative experience, profile country, self-declared gender, and verified ID, and can require a portfolio upload or recorded video response. Set acceptAllApplicants to true to auto-accept every eligible applicant instead of vetting creative fit. Requires wallet funds and RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY. Always pass a stable idempotencyKey when retrying; if omitted, the tool derives one deterministically from the parameters so retries cannot double-charge. If the wallet is short, use get_wallet_balance and deposit_wallet.

url.description: a string at most 2048 character(s) long
url.title: maxLength(2048)

artifacts.description: an array of at most 6 item(s)
artifacts.title: maxItems(6)

respondentCount.description: a number less than or equal to 100
respondentCount.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(100)

payPerRespondentCents.description: Integer cents paid to each accepted respondent. Minimum 50, or 10 for a quickVote run.
payPerRespondentCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(200000)

targetCategories.description: an array of at most 6 item(s)
targetCategories.title: maxItems(6)

allowedCountries.title: maxItems(30)

allowedGenders.description: Optional allowlist of self-declared profile genders. Omit for no gender restriction.
allowedGenders.title: maxItems(3)

identityRequired.description: Require respondents to pass the account-level government ID check before applying.

requireVideoResponse.description: Require each respondent to attach a recorded video response with their vote.

requirePortfolioUpload.description: Require each respondent to upload a portfolio sample with their application.

acceptAllApplicants.description: Accept every eligible applicant automatically instead of vetting creative fit. Eligibility checks and your country/gender restrictions still apply.

voteMode.description: Defaults to instant. Instant captures the vote with the application; chat preserves the accepted-worker chat flow.

quickVote.description: Opt in to quick votes: respondents tap one of exactly two image artifacts on the bounty list, with no rationale or voice note. Requires voteMode instant and no video or portfolio requirement. Defaults to false, which keeps the written-rationale contract.

autoMode.description: Defaults to true. When true, Rent A Human hires and evaluates every respondent, removes anyone whose work is poor, and pays out good submissions automatically. Set false to have every hiring and payout decision escalated to you instead.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. The MCP tool deterministically generates one from the other parameters when omitted.
idempotencyKey.title: maxLength(128)

tools.name: get_taste_run
tools.title: Get taste run
tools.description: Get a taste run status and, once closed, its summary, vote tally, winner, representative quotes, and degraded flag. While it is still running, poll again later or subscribe to run.report_ready webhooks.

tools.name: create_qa_run_template
tools.title: Create user testing run template
tools.description: Create a one-time or recurring human QA template for a target URL. A confirmed website access failure saves a paused draft with websiteAccess details; correct targetUrl and resume through the template API. Inconclusive checks allow launch. Every launch rechecks basic reachability, not the test steps. Set cadence to custom with cadenceDays from 1-30 for a custom interval. Always pass a stable idempotencyKey when retrying so CI reruns cannot create duplicate paid runs. Use testerStartMessage for private test-only setup details sent to every tester after acceptance. Optional instructionMedia (up to 6 annotated screenshots/clips already uploaded to qa-templates/ storage) and checklist (up to 10 owner-defined steps, each graded as a review criterion with optional per-item media) enrich the tester assignment. Use applicantScreening.liveVideoRequired, applicantScreening.linkedinRequired, and applicantScreening.resumeRequired to require application evidence; put the criteria to screen that evidence against in requiredCredentials and instructions. Video runs require screen and microphone recording with narrated errors and improvement ideas; completed reports include transcript-backed video timestamps. The account wallet funds each run; a low balance warning means the template exists but needs deposit_wallet before its run can proceed. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

targetUrl.title: maxLength(2048)

instructions.title: maxLength(5000)

payPerTesterCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500000)

testerCount.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(20)

applicantScreening.description: Optional application requirements: liveVideoRequired records a live camera video, linkedinRequired requires a LinkedIn profile, and resumeRequired requires an uploaded PDF, DOCX, or TXT resume. All default to false. Screening compares submitted evidence with requiredCredentials and task instructions.

items.description: a string at most 200 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(200)

requiredCredentials.description: an array of at most 10 item(s)

periodCapCents.description: a number less than or equal to 5000000

tools.name: get_qa_run
tools.title: Get user testing run
tools.description: Get an owned autonomous QA run with its status, budget totals, report, and finding diff. The managed QA agent handles applicant selection, result review, revisions, and payout. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_qa_runs
tools.title: List user testing runs
tools.description: List up to 100 owned autonomous QA runs newest first, optionally filtered by templateId. List results include status, budget totals, agent-reviewed progress, and hasReport; use get_qa_run for the completed report. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

templateId.description: Only return runs for this template
templateId.title: maxLength(1499)

tools.name: stop_qa_run
tools.title: Stop user testing run
tools.description: Stop one owned active QA run without pausing its recurring schedule. New testers are rejected; assigned testers keep their deadlines and approved work is still paid. Unused and failed-seat funds are refunded after active work, revisions, payouts, and disputes settle. Run history and evidence are retained. This is destructive and requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: create_negotiation
tools.title: Negotiation (retired)
tools.description: Retired for new orders: it now returns karen_orders_are_bounties and creates nothing. To hire a human negotiator (RentAKaren), call create_bounty with karen: true, priceType "hourly" (at least $5/h, $10/h with an English languageProficiencyRequirement), a deadline at least 4 days out, a general public title and description, and every personal detail (names, numbers, the full story) in startInstructions. Only approved Karens can apply, and they record every call. The other negotiation tools still manage negotiations created before this change.

title.description: Short title, e.g. "Lower my Comcast bill"
title.title: maxLength(120)

counterparty.description: Who the negotiator will deal with, e.g. "Comcast"
counterparty.title: maxLength(120)

context.description: Background the negotiator needs: account situation, history, leverage, deadlines.
context.title: maxLength(4000)

items.description: a string at most 2048 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(2048)

documentUrls.description: Up to 10 https links to supporting documents.
documentUrls.title: maxItems(10)

description.description: What the negotiator should achieve, e.g. "Lower my bill"
description.title: maxLength(200)

bonusCents.description: Flat bonus in cents paid only if you approve this objective as met. Escrowed up front; refunded if not approved.
bonusCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500000)

objectives.description: 1-5 objectives, each { description, target, bonusCents }. Objective IDs (obj_1, obj_2, ...) follow this order.
objectives.title: maxItems(5)

hourlyRateCents.description: Hourly rate in cents. Defaults to 2500.
hourlyRateCents.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(50000)

capMinutes.description: Maximum billable minutes (30-2400, multiple of 15). Billing never exceeds this cap.
capMinutes.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2400)

rightsConfirmed.description: Must be true: you hold or are authorized to negotiate this account.

mayDisclose.description: What the negotiator may disclose to the counterparty (account details, history).
mayDisclose.title: maxLength(1000)

mayAgreeTo.description: What the negotiator may agree to on your behalf without checking back.
mayAgreeTo.title: maxLength(1000)

neverCommitTo.description: Hard limits the negotiator must never commit you to.
neverCommitTo.title: maxItems(10)

recordingAllowed.description: Whether the negotiator may record calls (each opens with "This call is being recorded."). Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized in get_negotiation. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_negotiation
tools.title: Get negotiation
tools.description: Get one of your negotiations: status, brief, authorization, objectives with submitted evidence, logged and approved minutes, escrow breakdown, assigned negotiator, recorded calls (date, duration, outcome, negotiator notes, a 2–3 line summary and the full transcript; transcriptStatus is transcribing until it is ready), and settlement once settled. Calls are only recorded when authorization.recordingAllowed is true. Use it to find objective IDs for approve_objective. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_negotiations
tools.title: List negotiations
tools.description: List the negotiations you have posted with status, rate, cap, logged and approved minutes, escrowed amount, service fee and total wallet charge, and objective progress. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: fund_negotiation
tools.title: Fund negotiation
tools.description: Retry funding a pending_funding negotiation's escrow from your wallet after a top-up. Returns the shortfall when the wallet still cannot cover it. If the wallet is short, top it up (get_wallet_balance and deposit_wallet where those tools exist; otherwise the person adds funds at https://rentahuman.ai/account/wallet), then call fund_negotiation. Idempotent once funded. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: list_negotiation_applicants
tools.title: List negotiation applicants
tools.description: List the negotiators who applied to your negotiation, newest first: applicationId, name, status (pending, accepted, rejected…), cover letter and when they applied. Then call respond_to_applicant to hire one. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: respond_to_applicant
tools.title: Accept or reject applicant
tools.description: Accept or reject an applicant from list_negotiation_applicants. Accepting hires them as your negotiator from the funded escrow (the negotiation must be funded; nothing more is charged) and opens a conversation for message_negotiator; a negotiation has one negotiator. Rejecting is final for that application. message is an optional note shown to the applicant. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

message.description: Optional note shown to the applicant with the decision.
message.title: maxLength(1000)

tools.name: message_negotiator
tools.title: Message negotiator
tools.description: Send a message to the negotiator assigned to your negotiation, for example to answer a question or adjust instructions within your authorization. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: approve_hours
tools.title: Approve negotiator hours
tools.description: Approve every time entry your negotiator has logged so far. Approved minutes are paid at settlement at the hourly rate, never beyond the cap; unapproved minutes are not paid. Idempotent. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: approve_objective
tools.title: Review negotiation objective
tools.description: Approve an objective the negotiator marked as met, so its flat bonus is paid at settlement. Review the evidence from get_negotiation first. Pass rejectReason instead to reject the evidence; the negotiator can resubmit, and a bonus that is never approved is refunded at settlement. Approval is idempotent. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

rejectReason.description: Omit to approve. Provide a reason to reject the submitted evidence instead; the negotiator can resubmit.
rejectReason.title: maxLength(1000)

tools.name: settle_negotiation
tools.title: Settle negotiation
tools.description: Finish a negotiation: approved hours and approved objective bonuses are released to the negotiator from escrow, and everything unused is refunded to your wallet. Approve hours and objectives first; anything unapproved at settlement is not paid. Irreversible, but safe to retry. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: cancel_negotiation
tools.title: Cancel negotiation
tools.description: Cancel before a negotiator is hired; the whole escrow returns to the wallet. Fails once someone is hired. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

tools.name: create_bounty
tools.title: Create bounty
tools.description: IMPORTANT: A live create can immediately fund the bounty from the account's wallet. Always call with dryRun=true first, show the preview and fundingTotal to the operator, and only after their explicit approval call again with confirm=true. Create a one-shot task bounty that humans apply to. On create/edit, listing refusals return error_code, field and fix. Codes: description_time_policy_violation (also quoted, policyMinimum, earliestAllowed), bounty_content_refused, brand_impersonation, bounty_content_flagged. Follow fix, change field and retry; never retry unchanged wording. Preview with dryRun and show preview.fundingTotal before posting. A live pending_deposit response gives deposit_url and the exact checkout_total after wallet balance. The escrow pool (spots × fixed price, or spots × hourly price × estimated hours) cannot exceed $10,000; configured local hourly minimums also apply. idempotencyKey makes retries safe. Workers confirm within 2 hours unless skipAcceptanceConfirmation is true, then use startWindowMinutes and completionWindowHours. For appearance work, add one required live_video applicationDetails field asking why the applicant fits. Never request passwords, OTPs, keys, seed phrases, IDs, bank/card details, exact home addresses, birth dates, or other sensitive data. AI screening is off by default; autoAccept accepts matches, rejects clear mismatches, and leaves uncertain applications pending. aiManaged also turns on AI evidence review. RentAHuman or you approve payment.

title.description: Title of the task bounty (5-200 chars)
title.title: maxLength(200)

description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be done (20-5000 chars). Do not ask for the work sooner than the bounty's lead time (in-person notice for the city, 4 days for RentAKaren, the Signs lead time for sign holding): text like "ASAP, within 1 hour" is refused with 422 description_time_policy_violation, which returns quoted, earliestAllowed and fix.
description.title: maxLength(5000)

completionCriteria.description: Clear definition of done — what specifically counts as this task being completed.
completionCriteria.title: maxLength(2000)

evidenceTypes.description: How the human proves completion. At least one required. 'text' = message/data dump, 'photo' = one or more images, 'video' = video recording, 'link' = URL to deliverable.
evidenceTypes.title: minItems(1)

liveCaptureRequirement.description: Require accepted workers to capture new photo or video evidence from their device camera when submitting completion evidence. If both photo and video evidence are required, both must be captured live. Live video is limited to 60 seconds and 250 MiB. This requires the in-app camera workflow.

checkIns.description: Live selfie check-ins for in-person shifts: { enabled, intervalMinutes (whole minutes, 5-240) }. While a hired worker is on the job they take a camera-only, location-stamped selfie in the job chat every intervalMinutes from when they tap Start; you see each photo, its server time, distance to the job site and any flags, plus missed check-ins (never raw coordinates). enabled true requires an in-person bounty (location.isRemoteAllowed false). Omit it for the default: on every 15 minutes for sign-holding campaigns, off otherwise.

requirements.description: List of specific requirements for the task

city.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
city.title: maxLength(100)

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
state.title: maxLength(100)

country.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
country.title: maxLength(100)

location.description: Worker location target. Set country to an ISO country code without city or state to target every eligible worker in that country, including when remote work is allowed. Include city (and optionally state/country) for city-level targeting. Countries where RentAHuman is not available are rejected.

items.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(100)

supportedCountries.description: Countries whose workers may see and apply, as ISO country codes (country names are also recognized), e.g. ["US", "CA", "GB", "NZ", "AU"]. Omit it to keep the location-derived policy: a country-only location restricts the bounty to that country, an on-site city location keeps its existing country gate, and other locations stay unrestricted. When location.country is set it must appear in this list, and on-site bounties (isRemoteAllowed false) with a location country accept only that one country; use isRemoteAllowed true for a remote multi-country bounty. Countries where RentAHuman is not available and unrecognized values are rejected. With identityRequired, the list is enforced against the verified document country.
supportedCountries.title: maxItems(250)

deadline.description: Application cutoff (ISO 8601), based on the user’s schedule. The API validates location-specific minimum notice. Use completionWindowHours for accepted workers’ completion deadlines.

estimatedHours.description: Estimated duration in hours (e.g. 0.5 for 30min, 2 for 2h). Minimum 5 minutes (0.083).
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

priceType.description: Whether price is fixed or hourly

price.description: Per-worker price in the specified currency (minimum $1). In-person bounties inside a configured minimum-pay area must meet that area's hourly minimum; fixed prices are divided by estimatedHours for this check. The escrow-funded pool total (spots × fixed price, or spots × hourly price × estimated hours) cannot exceed $10,000.
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)

currency.description: USD (default and only supported bounty currency)

bountyKind.description: Agent-facing bounty creation only supports one-shot bounties.

spotsAvailable.description: Number of humans needed (1-2000, default: 1). The escrow-funded pool total cannot exceed $10,000.
spotsAvailable.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

responseWindowHours.description: Hours an accepted worker has to show activity (message or submission) before their seat is treated as ghosted. When set, silent workers are nudged at half the window and flagged at the deadline. 1-720 hours.
responseWindowHours.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

autoExpireGhosts.description: When true (and responseWindowHours is set), a ghosting worker’s seat is automatically released at the deadline: their application is expired, the seat is freed, and the listing reopens for other applicants.

completionWindowHours.description: Auto-reassign completion deadline: hours a worker has to complete the task after confirming their seat, or after scheduledStartAt when that is later. Any whole number of hours from 1 to 720 (30 days) is accepted, e.g. 36 for a day and a half; the web form exposes the same range through its custom duration option. Workers are reminded at half the window; when the deadline passes the seat is automatically released and the listing reopens for other applicants. Workers may request an extension, which you approve, deny, or replace with your own via POST /bounties/{id}/applications/{appId}/extension/decision. For AI-managed bounties this overrides the default 6-hour work window. Omit for no completion deadline. For tasks anchored to a specific future date or time slot (events, shifts, appointments), set scheduledStartAt or omit this: without a scheduled start the clock starts at seat confirmation, so a window shorter than the wait would release every worker before the task could start.
completionWindowHours.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

startWindowMinutes.description: Start commitment: minutes after the worker confirms their seat (or after acceptance when skipAcceptanceConfirmation is true) by which they must press Start or upload evidence, otherwise the seat is eligible for release. When scheduledStartAt is set, the window runs from the scheduled start instead, so a worker who confirms early keeps the spot until then. Whole number of minutes from 5 to 1440 (24 hours). Distinct from the fixed 2-hour seat-confirmation window and from completionWindowHours, the submission deadline.
startWindowMinutes.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1440)

attendanceRadiusMeters.description: In-person attendance: radius in meters around the job site (the bounty’s geocoded location) within which a hired worker counts as on site while attendance tracking is on. 50–2000, default 150. Only used when location.isRemoteAllowed is false.
attendanceRadiusMeters.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

scheduledStartAt.description: When the work starts, for tasks booked for a specific time (a shift, an appointment, an event). ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset, in the future, e.g. 2026-10-03T07:30:00-07:00. With startWindowMinutes, the start deadline is this time plus the window rather than confirmation plus the window; completionWindowHours likewise counts from this time, so a worker who confirms early keeps the spot until then. Recommended for in-person shifts: set it with scheduledStartTimeZone (and estimatedHours as the shift length) so workers already booked at that time are not shown or alerted about the bounty and cannot double-book. Omit for tasks that start as soon as the worker confirms. The API never reads a schedule from the description.

scheduledStartTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the task location (e.g. America/Los_Angeles), used to show workers the scheduled start in local time. Needs scheduledStartAt. Set it on in-person shifts: double-booking protection only uses a scheduled start that has its time zone.

signage.description: Sign-holding jobs: send 'poster_provided' only if you are bringing your own signs. Otherwise sign holding is booked through the Signs API (book_sign_campaign), where we print the sign and handle pickup, and a sign-holding shift that starts sooner than its lead time is refused with signs_lead_time.

id.description: Stable question ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the prompt.
id.title: maxLength(64)

prompt.description: Worker-facing question answered when submitting evidence. Blank rows are ignored. Max 300 characters.
prompt.title: maxLength(300)

required.description: Whether the worker must answer before their submission is accepted. Default true.

completionQuestions.description: Mandatory questions the accepted WORKER answers when submitting evidence (for example "Which counter did you use?"). Max 10, prompts up to 300 characters, required defaults to true. Distinct from applicationDetails, which screens applicants before acceptance. Visible to workers before they apply.
completionQuestions.title: maxItems(10)

keepApplicantsOnFill.description: When true, pending applicants are kept (not auto-rejected) even after every seat escrow settles, so you can reuse the applicant pool after reopening or adding seats. By default applicants are already kept while seats are merely filled and are only auto-rejected at settlement. Default false.

autoAccept.description: Enable AI screening to automatically review applicants as they apply; your blocklist always applies. Qualified applicants are accepted (the standard worker-confirmation window still applies unless skipAcceptanceConfirmation is set) and clear mismatches are rejected with a reason. Applications the review cannot decide stay pending for your manual review. Default false; pass true to enable AI screening, or leave it off to review and accept every application yourself. aiManaged: true turns it on. AI screening needs an application step.

autoAcceptMinMicScore.description: Minimum overall speech-quality score (1-5) an applicant’s mic-check recording must reach on micCheckRequired bounties. Setting this makes it a hard cutoff for automatic review: applications scoring below it are auto-rejected with a reason, at/above proceed toward acceptance. Unscored recordings always stay pending. When omitted, the platform default 3.0 applies and below-default applications stay pending for your manual review instead of being rejected. Only meaningful with micCheckRequired: true and autoAccept on.
autoAcceptMinMicScore.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(5)

identityRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an identity check (government ID) before applying. Verified once per account and reused across bounties. Default false.

excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.description: Exclude previous participants: ids of your own earlier bounties (max 1000). Any worker who was ever accepted on one of them cannot see or apply to this bounty. Editable later with PATCH. Ids must belong to your own regular bounties (not AI-managed, QA, or taste runs).
excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.title: maxItems(1000)

linkedinVerifiedRequired.description: Require applicants to have a verified LinkedIn: they must sign in with LinkedIn (OAuth) on their Rent A Human account before applying. A pasted LinkedIn URL does not count. Applicants without one get 403 with code "linkedin_verification_required". Use requiredLinks instead when you only need a LinkedIn URL. Default false.

micCheckRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an on-device microphone quality check (live recording scored for audio and speech quality) before applying. Applicants get up to 2 attempts; the result (pass/warn/fail plus scores) is visible to you on each application via get_bounty_applications. Default false.

language.description: Spoken language to assess. Only 'en' (English) is supported; other values are rejected.

minimumCefr.description: Minimum CEFR speaking band the applicant must reach: A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. Compared against the most likely band from a scored check.

languageProficiencyRequirement.description: Require applicants to pass an English speaking-proficiency check before applying. The applicant records about 45 seconds of spontaneous speech in the app; it is transcribed and scored automatically, and only a scored result at or above minimumCefr qualifies. Recordings that cannot be scored (too little speech, low confidence) ask the applicant to retry. A worker's scored level is saved on their profile as a lasting credential, reused across every bounty without retesting (only a newer scored check replaces it), and re-checked against the bounty's current threshold at acceptance; a stored level below your threshold still requires a new recording. Shape: { language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }. Omit for no requirement. Separate from micCheckRequired.

karen.description: RentAKaren order: hire an approved RentAKaren negotiator. Requires priceType 'hourly' at ≥ $5/h (≥ $10/h with an English languageProficiencyRequirement) and a deadline ≥ 4 days out (defaults to 14 days). Only Karens approved by RentAHuman can apply or be accepted. The hired Karen records calls in the in-app call console; final submission requires at least one call recorded by that worker (400 call_recording_required with callsPath). Follow callsPath while signed in to open the console. Buyers can review the recordings, summaries and transcripts. Put every personal detail (names, phone, account numbers, the full story) in startInstructions; keep title and description general (personal details in public fields are refused with karen_public_details). Cannot be changed after creation.

aiManaged.description: Let our AI run the bounty: AI screening reviews applicants and accepts qualified ones, and AI review checks submitted work; RentAHuman or you approve payment. Turns on autoAccept and aiGrading on an ordinary application bounty; a requested photo, video or document upload becomes the bounty's evidence type.

asOrg.description: Use only when organization settings are available for the authenticated account. Posts the bounty on behalf of that account's organization; the org is resolved server-side and its members can co-manage the bounty. Funding still comes from your own wallet. Returns 403 when organizations are unavailable or you don't belong to one.

submissionMode.description: How users submit to this bounty. 'application' shows the standard application form; 'photo_upload' shows consent and image upload; 'video_upload' shows consent and video upload; 'document_upload' shows consent and document upload.

maxImages.description: a number less than or equal to 4

tools.name: fund_bounty
tools.title: Fund bounty
tools.description: Fund an existing pending_deposit bounty. Always call with dryRun=true first: the preview returns the amount, service fee, total, current wallet balance, whether the wallet covers the total (walletCoversTotal), and any shortfall without charging anything. Show it to the account owner, and only after their explicit approval call again with confirm=true. A confirmed call may reserve available wallet funds immediately. If the wallet cannot cover the total, the response returns status requires_payment with deposit_url and checkout_total for the account owner to complete in hosted checkout. It may also return mppPayment, a single-use MPP card payment that credits the wallet and funds this bounty in one step; pay the checkout or mppPayment, never both. Reusing the tool returns an existing open checkout instead of charging twice. Unknown arguments are rejected. A bounty that is no longer pending_deposit returns 400. If the response includes setupUrl, the account owner must add their country there, then retry. Owner only.

dryRun.description: true returns a no-charge preview: amount, service fee, total, and current wallet balance. Nothing is reserved, charged, or started.

confirm.description: Must be true to fund. Set it only after showing the dryRun preview to the account owner and receiving their explicit approval.

tools.name: update_bounty
tools.title: Update bounty
tools.description: Update one of your ordinary one-shot bounties; only passed fields change. On create/edit, listing refusals return error_code, field and fix. Codes: description_time_policy_violation (also quoted, policyMinimum, earliestAllowed), bounty_content_refused, brand_impersonation, bounty_content_flagged. Follow fix, change field and retry; never retry unchanged wording. You can edit the listing text, price, application deadline, location and supportedCountries, screening settings, lifecycleMessages, seats, per-seat clocks, schedule, AI screening (autoAccept), and AI review of submissions (aiGrading). Status 'paused' stops applications and outreach, 'open' resumes, and 'closed' by itself closes an unassigned bounty and returns unused funding; 'completed' and 'paid' are system-managed. Use cancel_bounty to cancel. An edit cannot grow an escrow-funded pool above $10,000. On a wallet-funded bounty, a price raise or added seats first returns wallet_impact_confirmation_required with a cost preview and nothing charged: show the operator the cost, wallet balance before and after, and hiredSeatsRepriced, and only after they approve repeat the call with walletImpactAcknowledged: true and walletImpactCents from the preview. A raise after hiring reprices every hired worker. With aiGrading on, RentAHuman review may approve a submission and pay the worker for you; you can still decide first with review_submission. Clock changes (completionWindowHours, startWindowMinutes, responseWindowHours, autoExpireGhosts) apply only to seats confirmed after the edit; moving scheduledStartAt later pushes back confirmed workers' deadlines and never brings one forward. The 2-hour seat-confirmation window is fixed. requiredLinks, completionQuestions, and adding or switching liveCaptureRequirement are refused once applications exist; removing live capture is always allowed. AI-managed bounties allow only task-content and deadline edits; QA and taste runs and ongoing-bounty settings are not editable here.

languageProficiencyRequirement.description: Require applicants to pass an English speaking-proficiency check before applying. The applicant records about 45 seconds of spontaneous speech in the app; it is transcribed and scored automatically, and only a scored result at or above minimumCefr qualifies. Recordings that cannot be scored (too little speech, low confidence) ask the applicant to retry. A worker's scored level is saved on their profile as a lasting credential, reused across every bounty without retesting (only a newer scored check replaces it), and re-checked against the bounty's current threshold at acceptance; a stored level below your threshold still requires a new recording. Shape: { language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }. Omit for no requirement. Separate from micCheckRequired. Pass null to remove the requirement. Changing the threshold applies to new applications and to every pending applicant at acceptance time.

tools.description: Cancel one of your bounties by ID: pending and hired applications are closed and unreleased funding is refunded (wallet funds go back to your wallet). The response reports rejectedApplications and cancelledEscrows. A canonical reason is required; details are required only for other. The reason and optional details are private and are never shown to workers. Completed, paid or closed bounties cannot be cancelled. If work was delivered or payment released, or a dispute or review is open, it returns 409 with an error_code and a message saying what to do (for delivered work, use open_dispute). Safe to retry; a repeat returns alreadyCancelled: true.

tools.name: get_bounty_applications
tools.title: List bounty applications
tools.description: View applications to one of your bounties; while `hasMore` is true, pass the response's `nextCursor` as `cursor`. Applications come best match first (accepted first, rejected last, ties newest first). `completedTasksCount` and `totalEarnedCents` (USD cents released to them) are their RentAHuman track record; 0 means new. Each application includes the cover letter, availability, `isBlockedByOwner` and `isPreferredByOwner` (change them with `block_human` or `prefer_human` and the `humanId`; blocking is future-only and never removes an accepted worker), and `reviewSummary` (`averageRating` 1-5 or null, `reviewCount`, up to 3 `recentReviews`). A null averageRating with reviewCount 0 means no history, not a low score; weigh reviewSummary with `identitySignals` before accept_application. With a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, applications include `languageProficiency` with `status` passed, pending (still being scored), or failed, plus the scored `cefr` once scored. Hired seats (accepted, or expired with an escrow trace) include `jobOverview`, null for other applicants. Its `overallState` lets escrow state win over stale submission or chat state: released > resolved > refunded > disputed or rejected_disputed > seat_released > cancelled > the evidence state (awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_start, in_progress, evidence_in_review, changes_requested, redo_overdue, approved_awaiting_release, completed). `nextAction.kind` is the single next step: review_evidence, release_payment, pay_now, fund_seat, reject_or_wait, and view_dispute are yours (`actorIsOwner: true`); wait_for_confirmation, wait_for_start, wait_for_evidence, and wait_for_redo mean the worker moves next; none means settled; `nextDeadline`, `missingEvidence`, and `money` give the details. `isTeamReview: true` marks a disputed seat the platform team is reviewing because the 4-day poster review period lapsed (`teamReviewReopenUsed: true` once you used your single reopen); overallState and nextAction are unchanged.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty

tools.name: accept_application
tools.title: Accept application
tools.description: Accept a human's application for your bounty. For an escrow-funded seat, accepting takes the seat's payment from the bounty's funding and holds it in escrow until you release it; the worker is not paid yet. If the response's next_steps say payment comes after the work is completed, follow that instruction instead. For multi-person bounties, accept each applicant separately. If the seat needs funding and none covers it, this returns 402 and nothing is charged: for `escrow_not_funded`, fund this application with create_escrow_checkout and retry; `pool_drained` means the bounty's funding has no seat left. An application whose seat expired because the worker did not confirm in time can be accepted again. Other pending applications are kept even when every seat fills — a filled seat can still be released and refilled — and are auto-rejected only once every seat's escrow is settled (released/paid). Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating). Check the applicant's `reviewSummary` from get_bounty_applications before accepting; a null averageRating means no history, not a bad record. On bounties with a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, accepting an applicant whose current scored level does not meet the bounty's current threshold returns 409 `language_proficiency_unsatisfied`.

response.description: Optional message to the applicant, up to 1000 characters.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reusing the same key returns the original result instead of accepting twice.

tools.name: reject_application
tools.title: Reject application
tools.description: Reject a pending application to your bounty. The optional `response` is sent to the applicant as the reason.

response.description: Optional reason shown to the applicant, up to 1000 characters.

tools.name: get_bounty_submissions
tools.title: List evidence submissions
tools.description: List the evidence submissions workers have submitted for one of your bounties. Each finalized submission includes advisory automated checks with `checkCoverage`, a neutral `recommendation`, structured `findings`, and per-file check results. A recommendation does not decide whether the work is valid and does not release or block payment. Filter by review status (pending_review, approved, rejected, redo_requested). Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty whose evidence submissions to list

status.description: Filter submissions by review status: pending_review, approved, rejected, or redo_requested.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.title: Inspect evidence submission
tools.description: Get a single evidence submission for one of your bounties, including its uploaded files and advisory automated-check report. Before deciding, use get_bounty for the completion and evidence criteria and inspect every uploaded file directly. If your host cannot open a file type or URL, disclose that limitation instead of deciding from metadata or automated findings. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the evidence submission to retrieve

tools.name: review_submission
tools.title: Record evidence decision
tools.description: Record a decision on a worker's evidence submission. Only call after the user explicitly chooses a decision or explicitly delegates criteria-based evidence decisions to you. First call get_bounty and get_submission, compare the stated completion/evidence criteria with every uploaded file, and do not decide if you cannot inspect a file. `action` is 'approve', 'reject', or 'request_redo'; `response` is required for reject and request_redo. Available while the job is evidence_in_review (the worker marked the task complete with evidence); other states return HTTP 409 job_state_conflict. Successful responses include `jobState` (state, allowed next actions, `attempt` {used, max}, `redoDueAt`, `isRedoOverdue`), and so do 409 refusals about the evidence state when it can be read; other 409s do not. request_redo is capped at 3 cycles per job, after which HTTP 409 redo_limit_reached leaves only approve or reject. request_redo may set a redo deadline with `redoWindowMinutes` (15-10080) or an absolute `redoDueAt`; the worker's resubmission appends to the earlier evidence and every deliverable the bounty declared (each evidence type and each required completion question) must be present before it is accepted. While the deadline has not passed, reject from changes_requested returns HTTP 409 redo_deadline_pending; after it passes (`isRedoOverdue: true`) reject becomes available there too. Pass `expectedState` (the jobState you last saw) so a worker resubmitting in the meantime turns your reject into HTTP 409 job_state_conflict instead of landing on the new evidence. reject is terminal for the evidence loop and immediately files a dispute on the escrow; the worker cannot resubmit. If reject returns HTTP 409 dispute_unavailable, retry, or use request_redo instead. Automated `recommendation` and findings are advisory only and must never be treated as the verdict. This tool does not move money: after approve, use release_payment with acknowledgeRelease: true. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the evidence submission to review

action.description: Review decision: 'approve' accepts the evidence, 'reject' declines it, 'request_redo' asks the worker to resubmit corrected evidence.

response.description: Message shown to the worker. Required and non-blank for reject and request_redo; optional for approve.
response.title: maxLength(1000)

redoWindowMinutes.description: request_redo only: how long the worker has to add the requested evidence, in minutes (15-10080). Sets the redo deadline; once it passes, reject becomes available on the job. Mutually exclusive with redoDueAt.

redoDueAt.description: request_redo only: absolute ISO-8601 redo deadline, between 15 minutes and 7 days from now. Mutually exclusive with redoWindowMinutes.

expectedState.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the job state you last observed (e.g. 'changes_requested' when rejecting after a redo deadline). The review is refused with HTTP 409 job_state_conflict if the job has since moved, such as the worker resubmitting.

tools.name: report_support_issue
tools.title: Report support issue
tools.description: Report a RentAHuman platform error or support issue to the support team. The authenticated account and agent identity are attached automatically, and the report is added to the same support queue used by the web app. Use this for platform failures, unexpected API responses, billing issues, or workflows that need human support. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

summary.description: Short summary of the issue (max 160 characters)
summary.title: maxLength(160)

description.description: What failed, what was expected, and any useful reproduction details (max 5000 characters)
description.title: maxLength(5000)

priority.description: Optional operational priority for support triage

errorCode.description: Optional error code or exception name (max 200 characters)
errorCode.title: maxLength(200)

sourceTool.description: Optional MCP tool or workflow identifier where the issue occurred
sourceTool.title: maxLength(100)

tools.name: get_human_profile
tools.title: Get human profile
tools.description: Get detailed profile for a specific human by their profile ID.

humanId.description: The profile ID of the human

tools.name: search_bounties
tools.title: Search bounties
tools.description: Search for available bounties/tasks that humans can apply to.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.title: Get conversation
tools.description: Get a conversation and its first page of messages: up to 100, oldest first. When `pagination.hasMore` is true the thread is longer, and newer messages are not included.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to retrieve

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.title: List conversations
tools.description: List all conversations with humans.

unreadByAgent.description: If true, only return conversations with human messages not yet marked read. Reading a conversation with get_conversation does not mark it read.

hasReplies.description: If true, only return conversations with more than one message.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination — pass the nextCursor from previous response to get next page

onlyThisIdentity.description: If true, restrict results to conversations whose agentId exactly matches this MCP keypair's identity. Default false — the API returns all conversations under your user account (across MCP identities, web UI, and legacy keys).

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: Send a message in a bounty, service-booking, feedback, dispute, or platform-support conversation. Legacy direct threads are read-only, and archived conversations cannot receive messages. Keep contact details, links, and payment on RentAHuman. Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating). Hosted connections send text messages only; messageType and metadata are ignored.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to send a message to

agentName.description: Ignored; messages show the conversation's agent name.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for task_request or payment_offer messages

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key, kept for 24 hours. Reusing it returns the original successful result instead of sending a duplicate message.
